executive_summary:
This episode advances the Bride of Charlie investigation by presenting two principal evidentiary strands concerning the events of September 10, 2025 (the day of Charlie Kirk's assassination) and the immediate aftermath.

The first strand centers on Joe Kent's claims, made on Tucker Carlson, that the FBI/National Counterterrorism Center was stopped from continuing to investigate Charlie Kirk's death. The episode captures Andrew Kolvet's on-air admission that he provided a private group-chat text dump to Joe Kent, then claims Kolvet later declined to publish those texts when Kent suggested it. Alex Clark, Jack Posobiec, and Laura Loomer X posts are read aloud, establishing the public pressure campaign against Kent and the accusation that he leaked material specifically to harm Erika Kirk.

The second strand reconstructs Andrew Kolvet's location on September 10 via a displayed PR text chain (Kolvet, Justin Strief, Marina Medvin, Aubrey) and an on-screen calendar graphic. The text chain shows Kolvet reporting "this just loaded" after a ~2-hour absence, while Medvin simultaneously routes death-statement drafting to a 26-year-old employee because Andrew is "on a plane." The episode cross-positions this with Egyptian-plane transponding data and the Wyre sponsor plane's route. A Blake Neff audio clip ("I put that phone away") and a Joe Rogan podcast segment on Erika Kirk are also introduced as supporting artifacts.

Investigatively, the episode converts previously rhetorical claims about Kolvet's solo plane flight into a specific timeline-anchored discrepancy that can be tested against FAA/flight records.

claims.label: Joe Kent stated FBI halted NCTC investigation of Charlie Kirk assassination
claims.claim: Joe Kent told Tucker Carlson that the National Counterterrorism Center was stopped by the FBI from investigating the Charlie Kirk assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Kent's claims against any FBI/NCTC public statements; review case-file jurisdiction transfers to Utah authorities.

claims.label: Joe Kent described Charlie Kirk West Wing statement on Iran war
claims.claim: Joe Kent recounted that, in June in the West Wing stairway, Charlie Kirk said loudly that he had "stopped us from getting into a war with Iran."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via West Wing access logs and any corroborating witnesses to the June encounter.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet retweeted calls for Joe Kent's arrest
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet retweeted a post suggesting Joe Kent should be arrested for leaking classified documents.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via archived Kolvet X timeline.

claims.label: Alex Clark publicly accused Joe Kent of degrading Erika
claims.claim: Alex Clark posted on X that Joe Kent actively participated in or encouraged behind-the-scenes degradation of Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Clark's full X thread and any cited evidence.

claims.label: Jack Posobiec posted Joe Kent's military credentials
claims.claim: Jack Posobiec posted on X that Joe Kent has six bronze star medals with five oak leaf clusters across 11 combat deployments as a Green Beret.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check against DoD / military service records.

claims.label: Laura Loomer accused Kent of leaking to Candace to harm Erika
claims.claim: Laura Loomer replied to Posobiec accusing Joe Kent of leaking information to Candace Owens for the purpose of attacking Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Loomer's full post; trace whether she cites source for the accusation.

claims.label: Kolvet admitted providing text messages to Joe Kent
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated on Charlie Kirk's radio show that he had provided the group-chat screengrabs to Joe Kent in the immediate aftermath of Charlie's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full unedited radio segment; verify chain of custody.

claims.label: Kent suggested making texts public; Kolvet declined
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated Joe Kent messaged him suggesting the texts be made public; Kolvet declined because of concern for innocent group-chat members.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against any direct messaging logs or third-party corroboration.

claims.label: Kolvet unavailable 1:30pm–3:25pm Utah time in PR chat
claims.claim: In the Sept 10 PR text chain, Andrew Kolvet had no outgoing message from 1:30 p.m. until 3:25 p.m. Utah time, despite being the principal PR contact during the active crisis.
claims.investigative_direction: Timestamp-verify the chat export; cross-reference with FAA flight logs and cell-tower records.

claims.label: Kolvet stated "this just loaded" indicating plane travel
claims.claim: At 3:26 p.m. Utah time on Sept 10, Andrew Kolvet wrote in the PR chat: "Sorry, on the plane, this just loaded."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact wording against export; check plane Wi-Fi / message buffering logs if obtainable.

claims.label: Marina Medvin routed death-statement drafting to Aubrey citing Andrew's plane status
claims.claim: At approximately 2:05 p.m. Utah time on Sept 10, Marina Medvin called Aubrey and asked her to draft the staff death statement because Andrew was on a plane.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via call detail records and corroborate with Aubrey directly if possible.

claims.label: Aubrey was later fired over Uber-driver conversation
claims.claim: Aubrey, who drafted the Sept 10 death statement, was later terminated in connection with a conversation with an Uber driver that Marina Medvin reportedly overheard.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify with Aubrey or HR/witness records.

claims.label: Calendar shows Egyptian-plane transponding overlapping Sept 10 events
claims.claim: An on-screen calendar graphic places Egyptian-plane transponding windows (10:05–11:34 a.m.; second block) overlapping with Charlie's flight and Kolvet's unavailability window on Sept 10.
claims.investigative_direction: Independently source the ADS-B / transponder data; verify aircraft identifiers and operators.

claims.label: Wyre plane route: Scottsdale–Provo–Santa Barbara–Scottsdale
claims.claim: The Wyre-sponsored plane is shown on the on-screen calendar as routing Scottsdale → Provo (10:06 a.m.) → Santa Barbara (10:24 a.m.) → Scottsdale (1:44 p.m.) on Sept 10.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against FAA flight plan / tail-number tracking.

claims.label: Blake Neff's "I put that phone away" implies second phone
claims.claim: Blake Neff, describing his call to his mother after the shooting, used the phrasing "I put that phone away," which host interprets as implying possession of two phones.
claims.investigative_direction: Direct verification only possible via Blake Neff or device forensics.

claims.investigative_direction: Verify CIA documentary provenance and Erika's pageant participation against public records.
